title: Whole-ship architectural and autonomous-life coverage

scope.status: coverage and staged completion plan; not a declaration of completion
scope.priority: Finish the massive ship and mostly autonomous staff/guest daily life before new storyline/quests or detailed balancing. Preserve SunCorp/player setting and existing cleaning/economy.
scope.d09_role: Composition04 fitted architectural language approved by user for whole-ship refinement; current room/whole-ship completion remains open.
scope.why_no_percentage: Registry counts measure scope. Architectural, asset, lighting, functional and physical/persistent acceptance require different evidence and cannot be inferred from room counts.
scope.later_work: Facility reservations were observed being added to guest_life.gd after this snapshot. Until their owner supplies a validated handoff, related gaps mean unverified in this baseline, not a claim that later work is absent.

engine_and_interface_contract.units: metres; Y up; room records use deck-local Y
engine_and_interface_contract.world_render: existing 640 x 360 SubViewport/CRT stack; native HUD
forbidden_shortcuts: No capacity reduction or protected-interface move
No invented new rooms to explain decorative niches/reserve
No unapproved new deck holes or full cross-bridge grid

REGISTRY_NOW.method: Single external data-only script instantiates ship.gd, calls register_rooms/register_meal_seats, serializes dictionaries, frees the object. It never enters the scene tree, builds geometry, loads main.tscn or advances simulation.
REGISTRY_NOW.result: 1462 unique IDs, 18 decks, 1000 guest units, 2000 guest berths, 400 crew berths; registry data exactly matches revision03.

SPATIAL_ALL.scope: All 1462 recorded center/foyer routes, portal alignment/open/closed screens and sampled support; no per-room rendered or dynamic cart walkthrough.
SPATIAL_ALL.result: 1462 ordinary routes and sampled floors pass; 25 broad-body routes failed at that historical snapshot. Later D09 and crew checks have narrower superseding evidence.
SPATIAL_ALL.limits: These are historical facts. Do not subtract repaired samples to claim a fresh whole-ship pass.

D09_SPATIAL.scope: 110 D09 routes, 120 portals, 7990 support samples; salon eight activity and two care approaches; two terrace pockets; full tram reserve; one real spring-guided loaded-cart crossing.
D09_SPATIAL.result: Focused pass; three bottles retained across 1669 physics frames.
D09_SPATIAL.limits: No new full cleanup episode, every-bay parking, all appendages or final art approval. The lead confirms later profile/height changes do not alter this geometry; retained spatial pass remains applicable to unchanged modules. New art/geometry requires focused recheck.

CREW_PHYSICS.scope: 300 crew meal + 14/12/14 break + 16 changing approaches, and seven selected upper-theater connections.
CREW_PHYSICS.result: 356 ordinary/broad approach screens, 26866 support samples and selected connections pass after repair.
CREW_PHYSICS.limits: Static screens exclude final contact into seating; not all theater-seat routes, cart driving or crowd test.

LIFE_REPAIRS.scope: Production registry/lifecycle, continuous passenger day, continuous 48-hour crew run, crew reservation/break/training/traces, audience seat admission/routes/projection and dry-changing migration.
LIFE_REPAIRS.result: 399 autonomous crew ate/slept; 2298 real seated meal completions; 40 shared break reservations plus home overflow; 12 roles/59 assigned work rooms; 3400 logical routes reach actual seats. All 2000 passengers ate/slept/completed dinner; 4446 meals in the recorded continuous-day cohort.
LIFE_REPAIRS.limits: Not three completed daily meals for each person; no full physical crowd/service test. This supersedes old claims that crew meals, seat admission and dry changing do not exist.

PROFILE_PERSISTENCE.scope: ConfigFile old-profile import cases, population/home preservation, claimed partial event migration, idempotence and full original guest regression.
PROFILE_PERSISTENCE.result: Recorded zero failures; old/new D09 footprint positions and routes corrected without resetting homes or claims.
PROFILE_PERSISTENCE.limits: Not per-room collision, every prop/wallet/partial-dirt integration or every family migration acceptance.

ART_CURRENT.scope: D09 revisions and actual latest reference images; whole-room effects-on/off judgment.
ART_CURRENT.result: Revision03 improved enclosure but remains unapproved; later user rejected overall vibe. New integrated composition required.
ART_CURRENT.limits: Prior recommendation to show a direction checkpoint was not acceptance or rollout permission.

ART_BASELINE.scope: Frozen main-build still images and original bed/tidal-rest fixtures; broader atrium and room criticisms.
ART_BASELINE.result: Selected rest-asset readability passes; broad architecture/lighting remains unapproved.
ART_BASELINE.limits: No family-wide asset or full-ship art pass.

GAMEPLAY_OLD.scope: Historical per-ID source/model review at 01:23–01:32; no individual walkthrough.
GAMEPLAY_OLD.limits: Crew meals/breaks/training, audience seats, dry changing, room traces and profile import were subsequently improved; do not copy old deficits as current facts.

CAPACITY_OLD.scope: Historical capacity inventory and identified unverified facility/admission behavior.
CAPACITY_OLD.limits: Its 243 rooms with no numeric capacity fields, crew meals and changing failures are historical. Current registry has 239 with none of the six counted place fields, not necessarily 239 rooms with no occupant limit.

CORE.limits: Older core evidence, not acceptance of subsequent architecture.

PROFILE_MAIN.scope: Production main.tscn profile-prop migration and upper-floor incident visuals/aiming; upper incident is a diagnostic fixture.
PROFILE_MAIN.result: Eight recorded passes: stale player placement and cart relocation, original prop identities and spent dose, idempotence, unchanged valid prop motion, correct upper-floor incident elevation, supported same-floor aiming, no cleaning across floors by matching X/Z.
PROFILE_MAIN.limits: Focused affected-behavior evidence; no new all-room physical acceptance implied.

CHANGE_SCOPE.rule: Whole-file hash changes identify a new source snapshot but do not invalidate unrelated module evidence. Recheck only changed geometry/routes, affected behavior, interfaces and dependent areas. New art integration requires focused render/physical review.

MIDSHIP_CARE_SOURCE.limits: Presence in source is not a physical cart/restock acceptance test.

physical_access_persistence.historical_screens_only: Per-ID recorded center-route/door/floor screens retained; no all-route loaded-cart or individual save/load certification. Only affected geometry/routes/behavior need revalidation after a change.
physical_access_persistence.d09_focused_historical: Revision03 D09 all-room screens, salon activity/care/terrace and one real loaded-cart axis pass remain evidence for the unchanged geometry; profile/height behavior has separate current-main checks.
physical_access_persistence.crew_focused_historical: Selected crew/changing approaches and theater connections passed for their tested modules; final contact/full route/occupancy remain unverified. Recheck affected changes, not every unrelated doorway.

shared_design_rules: One existing registry and world-state owner. A local authored profile may refine an allocation; it does not create a replacement registry or extra rooms/berths.
For every family, decide how the plan makes arrival/use/privacy/view/circulation work and how section or threshold supports the same experience. Props and clipped corners alone are insufficient.
Join enclosure, built-in seating/storage, floor pattern, ceiling ribs/coves and visible light fixtures into one composition. Model real returns, supports, reveals and transition pieces.

Use original low-poly silhouettes and restrained 128–256 px small-prop / 256–512 px reusable texture trials as starting points, with coherent texel density. Preserve the current 640 x 360 world/CRT pipeline and crisp HUD. Approve with effects off as well as on.

Palette roles: pale structure, selected warm wood/fitted elements, blue-green recesses/textiles, restrained muted-brass joints and one local accent. Avoid the rejected continuous green stripe, unrelated puck furniture and detached canopy kit.
Three scales: room/void hierarchy, medium structural/fixture rhythm and sparse tactile objects with purpose/contact. Do not fill all open air or compensate for weak composition using clutter.

Visible fixture sources must illuminate nearby useful surfaces and faces with controlled falloff. Preserve bounded distant architectural light; do not raise global ambient to conceal poor material/light organization.

Honor actual nonuniform elevations, headroom, protected tram/cart reserves, door interfaces, body/bed/seat keys, theater openings and meaningful empty volume. Do not add exterior glazing through another room or a bridge-deck skylight.

Share approved compatible components and deterministic variants. Different rooms must differ because of program, privacy, hull relationship, morphology or desired activity, not random geometry or color.

Architecture, original craft, fixture/material light, autonomous function and physical/persistent behavior are independent acceptance dimensions. A registered room, generated seat, shader pass or route screen never establishes complete architecture.

Track changes at physical-module/behavior scope. A new whole-file hash does not require repeating unrelated doorway screens. Retain exact tested snapshots and add targeted evidence for changed geometry, routes, imported positions, prop recovery and incident height.
